actions.reason: Cache the initial byte vocabulary used by Tokenizer._build_vocab and copy it when rebuilding vocabularies, avoiding repeated construction of the same 256 single-byte entries during save/load workloads. Also read model files into lines before parsing in load, reducing per-line file iteration overhead while preserving the model format and loaded state.
